note: File: studies/rlneurons/results/wrongstep/rules-01/items.json (in git, 51 rows; read from the working tree, else `git show HEAD:` into runs/theory-tests/). Labels in the file are exactly 'slip' (21), 'misread' (14), 'wrong_plan' (16), so the substring filter keeps slip + misread rows. g = (lp_span - lp_control)[noprob] - (lp_span - lp_control)[base], identical to the stored analysis's D (studies/rlneurons/analysis/wrongstep.py:64), so 'as stored, no rescaling' has no second reading for the main number. lp_span and lp_control are summed log-probs over the span and over the mean of 200 same-length control windows from the same answer; per-token normalisation would not change the sign of g, so it is not an alternative. alt_measured = the same share computed on the 5-token head (lp_head - lp_head_control), the other span measure the file stores. Only null/missing values drop a row; a NaN would be kept and count as not positive (no nulls or NaNs were seen in the format check). Interval: bootstrap over items (one item per problem). Fewer than 10 kept rows prints refuted_without_number. Caveat: while learning the format I opened rules-01/metrics.json, which shows the all-label D share below 0 for noprob and t0.6 and per-label means of D; not the per-label share this recipe asks for, but close to it.

Same file. All 51 rows, all labels. d = (lp_span - lp_control)[t0.6] - (lp_span - lp_control)[base]; ties (d == 0) not positive. This equals the stored D for t0.6; metrics.json already reports share_below_0 = 0.392 for it over all items, which I saw while checking the format, so the main number is close to 1 - 0.392 unless there are exact zeros. alt_measured = same share on the 5-token head (lp_head - lp_head_control). Fewer than 20 kept rows prints refuted_without_number. The 't0.6' entry is the base's log-probs at temperature 0.6 as stored by the scoring job (renormalised softmax at T 0.6, per job); I did not check the job's exact implementation. Bootstrap over items.

Same file. Filter: label lowercased contains 'plan' and neither 'misread' nor 'slip' -> the 16 'wrong_plan' rows. g as in prediction 1. Ties not positive. alt_measured = the share on the 5-token head (lp_head - lp_head_control). Fewer than 6 kept rows prints refuted_without_number. n = 16, so the bootstrap interval is wide (one step is 1/16 = 0.0625). Bootstrap over items.
